highlights: EuG T-656/24 (European Air Charter, 04.03.2026): autonomous airline decision to wait for passengers from an earlier flight can break the causal link to an extraordinary circumstance of that earlier flight -> airline cannot rely on Art. 5(3) for the subsequent flight.

EU Council/Parliament June 2026 political agreement on first air-passenger-rights reform in 22 years: 3-hour compensation threshold kept; new 96h notification + 30-day reply duty; no-show protection; hand baggage included by default.
EU agreement prevents airlines (e.g. Ryanair) from forcing passengers to download an app for a boarding pass.
